description: Helps developers migrate Java Spring Boot 3.x projects to 4.x by analyzing code, dependencies, and configurations.

prompts.description: Check current Spring Boot version and dependencies
prompts.prompt: Analyze the project and identify the current Spring Boot version and all Spring dependencies.

prompts.description: Identify breaking changes in Spring Boot 4.x
prompts.prompt: List all potential breaking changes when migrating from Spring Boot 3.x to 4.x, including configuration properties, deprecated APIs, and starter modules.
Provide updated Maven or Gradle dependencies compatible with Spring Boot 4.x.
Suggest changes in code, annotations, and packages required for Spring Boot 4.x compatibility.
Provide updated application.properties or application.yml examples compatible with Spring Boot 4.x.
Provide steps and sample test cases to verify migration is successful, including Spring Boot test annotations and sample integration tests.
